# Criteo OneTag

Apply the [media contract](../../media/common.md) and its linked implementation owners.

## Resolve the exact OneTag product

Establish account/partner, business use, page/event coverage, source actions, catalog convention and
environment. Research browser OneTag, GTM, event/product/transaction and consent contracts from
https://help.criteo.com/ and inspect the installed template.

Reconcile site/partner/plugin/GTM owners. Current template capability determines initialization,
page-view/SPA behavior and separate tags versus dispatcher. Account/partner, page type, event and
feed identities remain distinct. Success-based conversions use the approved application occurrence.

## Project product and transaction data

Listing, product, basket and transaction payloads use their exact current product ID, quantity,
price/value, currency, transaction and array contracts. The actual Criteo feed convention supplies
identifier semantics. Apply [mapping](../../data/mapping.md) for complete item projection and source
readiness; selected matching follows [identity](../../data/identity.md).

## Verify

Check OneTag initialization, account/page/event identity, complete product/transaction fields,
selected consent and environment. Record feed/account setup, audiences and platform rules externally.

## Server route

Load [Server](server.md) for the explicitly named Criteo server product and its own supported contract.
